description: Known vulnerabilities accepted temporarily. Each entry needs a reason and expires within 30 days; scripts/audit_dependencies.py fails on unlisted, expired or stale entries.

exceptions.reason: Fixed in certifi 2026.10.19 (2026-10-20), younger than the 14-day release-age policy. The finding is a distrusted root certificate (emSign ECC Root CA - G3); the only outgoing HTTPS call is the optional OpenAI API with a fixed base URL. Update once the release is older than 14 days (from 2026-11-03).

Fixed only in pillow 13.0.0 (2026-10-16), which needs streamlit>=1.66 (2026-10-14); both are younger than the 14-day release-age policy. Pillow is a transitive Streamlit dependency; this project never decodes, uploads or saves images, so the TIFF/GIF/PDF/EPS parsing paths are not reachable. Update once both releases are older than 14 days (from 2026-10-30).
